test_dataframe_arrow_interface: test the DataFrame.__arrow_c_stream__ method to export a pandas DataFrame as an Arrow C stream capsule
test_dataframe_to_arrow: test pa.RecordBatchReader.from_stream to convert a pandas DataFrame into a PyArrow table with optional schema
test_dataframe_from_arrow: test pd.DataFrame.from_arrow to import PyArrow tables and record batches into pandas DataFrames
test_arrow_stream_wrapper: test the ArrowStreamWrapper class that delegates __arrow_c_stream__ for custom Arrow stream objects
test_arrow_array_wrapper: test the ArrowArrayWrapper class that delegates __arrow_c_array__ for custom Arrow array objects
